Quinn.build: Build armor first against Quinn's damage. You don't need to build magic resistance to block this opponent's damage.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down, hit her with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach by stepping on the dropped axe and use basic attacks. Once you're on her, use Olaf W Tough It Out for a shield and attack speed, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing for the finishing hit. If Quinn E Vault is still available, use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after it impairs your movement.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is used is your window to close the distance. Before then, don't force an approach alone. When Quinn E Vault is down, chase with the slow from Olaf Q Undertow and your axe-retrieval path.
Quinn.fight: Start a trade when Quinn E Vault is down or when your jungler can follow up. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in Quinn's direction of movement and where you can retrieve the axe, slowing her as you chase. If Quinn E Vault hits you, use Olaf R Ragnarok to ignore the movement impairment, but keep an eye on your health since you still take the damage.
Quinn.laning: Early on, don't blindly enter Quinn's range. Use Olaf Q Undertow to last hit and preserve your health and growth. Don't throw the axe to poke if you won't be able to retrieve it. Farm while Quinn P Harrier is not marking you, and look for a chance to fight after Quinn E Vault is down.
Quinn.phase: In the early laning phase, Quinn's range means Olaf should focus on preserving health and growth.
Quinn.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow toward Quinn in time with your physical-damage allies' engage to use its slow and armor reduction. Use Olaf R Ragnarok to ignore movement impairment as you approach Quinn in the backline. Once you're on her, keep up the pressure with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing. Watch for Quinn flanking and fight with your team.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, watch out for her empowered basic attack and step outside her attack range to let the mark expire. Quinn E Vault knocks away and slows an approaching Olaf, so don't force your way in while this ability is available. Avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line, and if your vision is reduced, don't throw skillshots during that time.

Aurora.fight: Don’t blindly run at ranged Aurora; wait for her poke spell to be down, then approach while slowing her with Olaf Q Undertow. Step on the axe where it lands to retrieve it and fight up close with basic attacks, but don’t prolong the fight at low health when the recast damage of Aurora Q Twofold Hex is dangerous.
Aurora.teamfight: Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Aurora’s crowd control hits to reach her in the backline. If Aurora jumps in and nobody is killed, take that moment as an opportunity. When retreating, don’t leave low-health allies behind.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, and her passive scales with maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance over simply stacking health. If the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration can turn the fight, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Aurora.combo: Hit Aurora with Olaf Q Undertow in her direction of movement, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking Aurora’s attacks, counterattack with the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out, and use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. If Aurora uses Aurora W Across the Veil to become stealthed, wait to attack until she is revealed.
Aurora.escape: Use the moment both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down as your chance to engage. When you are hit by crowd control, activate Olaf R Ragnarok and stay on her.
Aurora.laning: Secure last hits with Olaf Q Undertow to preserve your level and growth. Throw the axe where you can retrieve it as you approach, and don’t waste it on poke if you can’t retrieve it. Engage when Aurora’s poke spell is down or you have jungle support.
Aurora.phase: In mid game, if you get on Aurora while her mobility spell is down, Olaf’s physical damage lands well against her low armor. Later, it becomes harder to reach teams with long range, so choose your engage carefully.
Aurora.watch: The return damage of Aurora Q Twofold Hex increases the more health you have lost. If you are cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself, and retreat before the curse is drawn back if your health is low. After Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, you may be slowed when leaving its area, so decide whether to get out before it appears.

Tryndamere.combo: Slow Tryndamere with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking one of his attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out to use the shield and attack speed, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don't pour in your finishing damage; attack again after its duration ends.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after making Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is Olaf’s chance to go in. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout is also down, Olaf can chase without worrying about the slow. When Olaf needs to retreat, he should walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere's main damage is physical and critical, so build armor first. Consider Thornmail against an opponent who relies on basic attacks. If Tryndamere Q Bloodlust's healing could turn a fight around, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Tryndamere.fight: Close the gap right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash has been used. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Tryndamere is moving, where you can retrieve the axe as you approach, then fight with basic attacks once you're on him. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout's slow is about to hit or has just hit, use Olaf R Ragnarok to withstand it, but keep in mind that you'll still take the damage.
Tryndamere.laning: Harass Tryndamere from the start to make last hitting difficult and prevent him from building Fury. Throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and him so retrieving the axe and closing in happen in one motion; don't throw it where you can't retrieve it. When Tryndamere starts building Fury by attacking minions, he may engage soon, so manage your distance.
Tryndamere.phase: In the mid game, keep looking for a window after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash has been used, but don't try to kill him while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active. In the late game, Olaf can struggle to reach a long-range team, so avoid fighting alone in a side lane against Tryndamere while his ultimate is ready.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Slow enemies along your engage path with Olaf Q Undertow and reduce their armor to help your allies deal physical damage. Activate Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after crowd control comes out, then get onto the backline carries. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don't focus your damage on him; create distance and wait out its duration.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury's critical strikes and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust's healing become more threatening as his Fury builds, so be wary of a fight when he builds Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, and critical strikes reduce its cooldown, so don't chase him where there are many minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don't pour in more damage; create distance and wait out its duration.

Aatrox.laning: Early on, farm without giving Aatrox a kill, and look for a trade after his empowered Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance attack has been used on a minion. Throw Olaf Q Undertow so the axe lands between you and Aatrox, letting you retrieve it as you approach. Dodge first if you are within range of the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and don’t force a trade if you can’t retrieve the axe.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the gap. If Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade’s knockup and Aatrox W Infernal Chains’ pull are down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and move in while retrieving the axe. If his crowd control is still available, don’t use Olaf R Ragnarok in advance as you engage; use it just before or after you are hit.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Use Olaf Q Undertow’s armor reduction and Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage against Aatrox’s high armor. If his healing can turn the fight, build armor, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Aatrox.combo: When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, throw Olaf Q Undertow in his direction of movement and approach while retrieving the axe. Get close and use basic attacks, then activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking Aatrox’s attacks, and use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade or Aatrox W Infernal Chains impairs your movement, then stay on him and keep attacking.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses his empowered Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance attack on a minion or casts Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Hit him with Olaf Q Undertow to slow and reduce his armor, then close in while retrieving the axe. After taking one of Aatrox’s attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed, then counterattack. Save Olaf R Ragnarok until Aatrox uses crowd control, and delay the duel if Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.phase: However, Aatrox can get far ahead with an early lead, so farm without giving him a kill and choose your trade windows carefully. Later, Olaf has trouble reaching teams with long range, so choose your teamfight approach carefully.
Aatrox.teamfight: When an ally who deals primarily physical damage engages, hit Aatrox with Olaf Q Undertow to reduce his armor. Use Olaf R Ragnarok to bypass movement impairments and reach the backline carries instead of fighting the frontline for too long. If the approach is narrow, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to slow them, then enter while retrieving the axe.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you airborne, so watch the cast and dodge outside the blade’s tip range or close in. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately leave its area to avoid being pulled. If escape is difficult, use Olaf R Ragnarok and take the movement impairment. While Aatrox R World Ender is active, healing can turn the duel, so create distance and let it run out.

Garen.watch: If you engage first while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active, its silence can stop your retaliation. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, get out of its range; if you can’t, move among allied minions. If your health is below half, stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice range, since it deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice can’t be reduced by resistances, so consider your total health too. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance could turn a fight, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Garen.combo: When Garen Q Decisive Strike is down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach while retrieving the axe and attack with basic attacks. After taking one of Garen’s attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed. Once Garen W Courage’s brief shield window has ended, use Olaf E Reckless Swing as the final hit.
Garen.escape: Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so the moment after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is used is your chance to catch him. Hit Garen in the direction he’s moving with Olaf Q Undertow to slow him, then follow as you retrieve the axe.
Garen.fight: Trade just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is used. Throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can pick it up as you close in, and don’t stay near Garen for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning. Don’t pour damage into Garen right after he activates Garen W Courage; wait for its brief shield window to end before using Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Garen.phase: In the mid game, keep pressuring Garen so he doesn’t have time to build Garen W Courage’s permanent stacks. The matchup gets harder as the game goes on, so shut him down early and keep in mind that Olaf may struggle to approach a long-range team later.
Garen.teamfight: Time Olaf Q Undertow with an engage from allies who deal primarily physical damage to reduce the enemies’ armor. Activate Olaf R Ragnarok in response to the opponent’s movement impairing effects and approach the backline damage dealers. After activating it, keep hitting champions with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing to extend its duration.

Gangplank.phase: Later, Olaf will have trouble getting close to a long-range team, and the available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage against this opponent in the late game.
Gangplank.build: Build armor early, starting in lane, against Gangplank Q Parrrley’s poke and Gangplank E Powder Keg’s physical damage. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy could turn a fight, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so withstand them with your total health pool.
Gangplank.combo: For an all-in, use Olaf Q Undertow hit → approach while retrieving the axe → basic attacks → Olaf W Tough It Out → Olaf E Reckless Swing. Activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking one hit from Gangplank, so you can use its shield and attack speed to trade back. Save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish, but hold it if your health is low and the kill is uncertain, since it costs health.
Gangplank.escape: If Gangplank has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg and there are no primed kegs nearby, that’s an opening to engage. After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, he can no longer cleanse Olaf Q Undertow’s slow, making it a good time to close in again. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after being slowed by Gangplank E Powder Keg or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.fight: Engage and trade just after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, while the keg is still unprimed. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Gangplank is moving and along a path where you can pick up the axe, then follow up with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, watch whether he uses it, since he can cleanse Olaf Q Undertow’s slow.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, use Olaf’s strong melee trading to look for openings before Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed. Throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can pick it up and close in between you and Gangplank. Don’t enter an area with a nearby primed keg or two overlapping kegs.
Gangplank.teamfight: Time Olaf Q Undertow with an engage from allies who deal primarily physical damage to reduce the armor of Gangplank and any other enemies hit. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when slowed by Gangplank E Powder Keg or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, then keep on the backline damage dealers with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing. Check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used when deciding when to fight for an objective.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows, and older kegs are more likely to explode. Back off if a primed keg is nearby, and destroy kegs yourself when you can do so from outside the blast radius. Gangplank R Cannon Barrage also slows and deals true damage, so remember that Olaf R Ragnarok lets you ignore the slow but you still take the damage.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali’s main damage. Get health to withstand the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution, and consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Akali.combo: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in Akali’s direction of movement to slow her, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking Akali’s attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. If your health is low and a kill is not certain, hold Olaf E Reckless Swing, considering its health cost.
Akali.escape: After dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip, look for a chance to engage. If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip is down, check her remaining mobility before going in; especially look for a window when Akali R Perfect Execution is also down. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Akali Q Five Point Strike’s slow prevents you from chasing.
Akali.fight: After taking one of Akali’s attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed as you fight up close. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after Akali Q Five Point Strike slows you.
Akali.laning: Early on, build a health and CS lead through melee trades. Throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve the axe between Akali and yourself as you approach. If you can’t retrieve it, don’t throw it recklessly; Akali can counterattack during the downtime before your next Olaf Q Undertow.
Akali.phase: Later, it becomes harder to reach teams with long range, so engage during an opening when Akali’s mobility is down.
Akali.teamfight: Time Olaf Q Undertow with an ally’s physical damage engage to reduce Akali’s armor. If Akali briefly reveals herself just after entering Akali W Twilight Shroud, throw Olaf Q Undertow at that spot.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, her second dash follows your escape path, and the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution becomes more dangerous the more health you have lost. You can throw Olaf Q Undertow when Akali briefly reveals herself just after entering Akali W Twilight Shroud.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage aside from Camille Q Precision Protocol. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage can’t be reduced with resistances, and Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with maximum health, so be careful about simply stacking health. If the healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep can turn the fight, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Camille.combo: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in Camille’s direction of movement to slow her, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. Follow with Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing. If Camille E Hookshot’s stun is incoming, activate Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after it lands and stay on her, continuing to attack.
Camille.escape: When Camille E Hookshot is down, you have a chance to approach, but Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum can still move her if it is available. Go in during a window when both abilities are down, especially before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up. If you have to take the stun from Camille E Hookshot, use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after it.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; engage once the shield has been stripped away. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after Camille E Hookshot stuns you, then keep attacking. After taking one of Camille’s attacks, counterattack with the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out, and use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish.
Camille.laning: Camille is weak early before her first core item, so take lane control and pressure her farm with Olaf’s strong early trades. Don’t get pushed toward a wall, and throw Olaf Q Undertow where the axe can be retrieved between you and Camille. If you can’t approach while retrieving the axe, there will be downtime before your next Olaf Q Undertow, so don’t force a trade.
Camille.phase: Early on, Olaf is strong in melee trades and Camille is weak before her first core item, so take lane control. From mid game onward, Camille can quickly destroy side lane turrets, so don’t leave the side lane unattended. Later, account for how difficult it is for Olaf to reach teams with long range.
Camille.teamfight: Slow Camille and reduce her armor with Olaf Q Undertow to benefit allies dealing physical damage as well. Time Olaf R Ragnarok with Camille E Hookshot’s stun, and reach the backline carries instead of getting stuck fighting the frontline for too long. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum traps you, wait out the area’s duration, then counterattack.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to dash in and stun you, and can be followed by Camille W Tactical Sweep, so stand away from walls. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum traps you, it is difficult to get out, so avoid engaging first; if trapped, wait out its duration, then counterattack.

Chogath.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. If the healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore can turn the fight, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage and can’t be blocked with resistances, while E Vorpal Spikes scales with maximum health, so be cautious about simply stacking health.
Chogath.combo: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in Cho'Gath’s direction of movement and hit him, then approach while stepping on the axe where it lands. Get close and use basic attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing. When crowd control is about to hit, such as just before Cho'Gath Q Rupture’s knockup reaches you, use Olaf R Ragnarok and stay on him, continuing to attack.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility spell, so the moment Cho'Gath Q Rupture or W Feral Scream is down is your chance to engage. Conversely, if both are available, manage your distance first, since Olaf has no spell to get himself out. When retreating, throw Olaf Q Undertow along the escape route behind you and retrieve the axe as you leave.
Chogath.fight: Approach after dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture sideways or once Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is down. Hit him with Olaf Q Undertow, retrieve the axe as you close in, then trade with basic attacks. After taking Cho'Gath’s combo, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed, and only use Olaf E Reckless Swing when a finish is certain.
Chogath.laning: Early on, push the lane or apply pressure to limit Cho'Gath’s chances to stack. Don’t stand in line for Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes from behind minions, and throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve the axe while approaching. There is an opportunity to look for a gank right after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he stacks, so keep limiting his growth through mid game; the matchup gets worse for Olaf later. Don’t give up a stack by getting killed by Cho'Gath R Feast when your health is uncertain.
Chogath.teamfight: Time Olaf Q Undertow with an ally’s physical damage engage to make use of its armor reduction. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Cho'Gath’s crowd control hits to get through and reach the backline carries. Cho'Gath R Feast still damages you while Olaf R Ragnarok is active, so watch its range if your health is low.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture marks the ground before knocking you airborne and slowing you, so dodge sideways as soon as you see the mark. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences in front of him, making the following Q harder to dodge, so don’t start trades from the front. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pass through minions and deal damage based on maximum health, so stand clear of the line when he attacks. If your health is at or below half, watch out for Cho'Gath R Feast’s range, as armor can’t block its damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Armor alone can’t keep you safe because Darius E Apprehend pierces armor and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate can turn the fight, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is down, hit him with Olaf Q Undertow in his direction of movement to slow him, then approach while retrieving the fallen axe and use basic attacks. Activate Olaf W Tough It Out and keep using basic attacks, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. Just before or after Darius E Apprehend hits you, use Olaf R Ragnarok to clear movement impairments and stay on him, continuing to attack.
Darius.escape: The window for Olaf to engage is when Darius E Apprehend misses or is unavailable to cast again. Conversely, if Hemorrhage has stacked several times and your health is uncertain, get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine range.
Darius.fight: When Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, slow and reduce his armor with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach. When he casts Darius Q Decimate, dodge the blade’s edge or stand close to reduce his healing, then attack. Disengage from a fight where Darius P Hemorrhage has stacked up heavily; when you reengage, use Olaf W Tough It Out’s shield and Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage.
Darius.laning: In early melee trades, throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and Darius so you can retrieve the axe as you approach. Poke from outside Darius E Apprehend’s range, then trade damage when Apprehend is down or just after Darius uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions. If Hemorrhage stacks build up, back off briefly to let them expire, then look for another opening.
Darius.phase: Darius is also strong in early skirmishes, so choose a window when Darius E Apprehend is down. Later, Olaf has trouble reaching teams with long range, so watch your approach path and when Darius uses crowd control.
Darius.teamfight: Reduce Darius’s armor with Olaf Q Undertow to benefit allies dealing physical damage as well. Time Olaf R Ragnarok with Darius E Apprehend, and reach the backline carries instead of staying on the frontline for too long. If Darius R Noxian Guillotine kills you with multiple Hemorrhage stacks, its cooldown resets, so get out of its range in that situation.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you are vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so poke from outside its range and fight after it is down. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move out of the blade’s outer edge or stand close to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, create distance to let the stacks expire, and don’t stay within Darius R Noxian Guillotine range with multiple stacks.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper can turn an extended fight, build resistances, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
DrMundo.combo: Hit Dr. Mundo with Olaf Q Undertow in his direction of movement, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking his attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed, and save Olaf E Reckless Swing as the finishing blow.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no spell to create distance, so when you have an angle to approach, use Olaf Q Undertow’s slow and retrieve the axe to get on him. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw slows you, but don’t waste time chasing if Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.fight: Use Olaf R Ragnarok when you need to take the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then continue the fight up close with basic attacks and E Reckless Swing.
DrMundo.laning: Put minions between you and Dr. Mundo to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve the axe as you approach. After a fight, step on the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases along your retreat path to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: In mid game, look to dive or force an objective when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down. Later, your approach is more easily blocked, so don’t spend time on Dr. Mundo; look for another target.
DrMundo.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow at Dr. Mundo as allied physical damage champions engage to make use of its armor reduction. In teamfights, use Olaf R Ragnarok to bypass movement impairments and reach the backline carries instead of fighting in front of Dr. Mundo for too long.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw deals damage based on current health and slows the first target it hits, so be especially careful at high health and dodge from behind minions. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t insist on getting a kill during that time.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If the healing from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge can turn the fight, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Fiora R Grand Challenge deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about simply stacking health.
Fiora.combo: In a window when Fiora W Riposte is down, hit her with Olaf Q Undertow, then close in while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking her attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out, and save Olaf E Reckless Swing as the final blow.
Fiora.escape: Just after Fiora uses Fiora Q Lunge is Olaf’s window to engage. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, you have less reason to worry about her counterattack, so slow her with Olaf Q Undertow and close in while retrieving the axe.
Fiora.fight: Close the gap just after you make Fiora use Fiora Q Lunge. First bait out Fiora W Riposte or sidestep its hitbox, then land Olaf E Reckless Swing. After taking one of her attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out to use its shield and attack speed together.
Fiora.laning: Early on, stand on the opposite side of a vital and wait for Fiora to engage with Fiora Q Lunge, then counterattack. Throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and her, where you can retrieve the axe as you approach. After a short trade, don’t chase recklessly.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals. Time Olaf Q Undertow with an ally dealing physical damage as they engage to make use of its armor reduction. Activate Olaf R Ragnarok when the enemy’s crowd control hits, then stay on the backline carries and continue attacking with basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks an attack and strikes back, so check that Riposte is down before using Olaf E Reckless Swing. Watch for Fiora Q Lunge when she approaches toward a vital, and stand on the opposite side of the vital to limit her approach angle. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall to block one of the vitals.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against the damage from Gnar Q, E, and R. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone. Consider tenacity if you’re concerned about Mega Gnar’s wall stun.
Gnar.combo: Hit Gnar in the direction he’s moving with Olaf Q Undertow, then pick up the axe as you close in and attack with basic attacks. After taking Gnar’s retaliation, use Olaf W Tough It Out for the shield and attack speed, and save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before Gnar’s slow or stun lands, or right after it hits.
Gnar.escape: The moment after you make Gnar use Gnar E Hop / Crunch is your chance to close the gap. You can also look for an all-in just after he changes from Mega back to Mini, while he can’t transform again. If Gnar still has crowd control available, don’t activate Olaf R Ragnarok early; time it for when that ability comes out.
Gnar.fight: Engage just after Mini Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch, or right after he changes from Mega back to Mini. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Gnar is moving, then pick up the axe as you close in. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before Gnar’s crowd control lands or right after it hits, and keep on him.
Gnar.laning: Don’t blindly charge in while taking Mini Gnar’s ranged poke. Last-hit and scale with Olaf Q Undertow, throwing the axe where you can pick it up as you close in. Step out of Mini Gnar’s boomerang path to make it harder for Gnar to retaliate. Look for a fight after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down or when you have jungle help.
Gnar.phase: Early on, protect your level and growth while watching out for Mini Gnar’s ranged poke. Later, Olaf will have trouble getting close to a long-range team, so choose your teamfight entry carefully.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid standing with your back to a wall or in a narrow approach where Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into a wall. If Gnar has just changed from Mega back to Mini, that’s a chance to start a teamfight with your allies. Use Olaf Q Undertow to make an entry path, then time Olaf R Ragnarok for Gnar’s crowd control and stick to the backline damage dealers.
Gnar.watch: Watch for the slows from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, and dodge Mini Gnar’s boomerang on its return path too. If Gnar is about to transform, avoid a head-on fight, and don’t stand with your back to a wall where Mega Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into it and stun you.

Gwen.build: Consider magic resistance items such as Spectre's Cowl first against Gwen’s primary magic damage. Olaf Q Undertow’s armor reduction and penetration help against the increased armor from Gwen W Hallowed Mist, and you can also use Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage. If Gwen’s healing could turn a fight, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Gwen.combo: Hit Gwen in the direction she’s moving with Olaf Q Undertow to slow her and reduce her armor, then approach as you retrieve the axe. Once you’re on her, attack with basic attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking Gwen’s damage, and finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t try to use Olaf E Reckless Swing from outside the mist; enter it or wait for it to end.
Gwen.escape: The moment after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down is your chance to close the gap. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after Gwen R Needlework’s slow lands, then stay on her with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing to extend its duration. If Gwen has already used up her slows, don’t use Olaf R Ragnarok early to engage.
Gwen.fight: Fight right after you make Gwen use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, before stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! build up. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Gwen is moving and along a path where you can pick up the axe. Retrieve it, close in, and pressure her with basic attacks. Dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to the side, and use Olaf W Tough It Out’s shield and attack speed after taking damage and losing health.
Gwen.laning: Early on, look to trade before stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! build up. Drop Olaf Q Undertow between you and Gwen so you can retrieve it as you close in, and don’t force a trade from an angle where you can’t pick up the axe. When you aren’t fighting, stay out of range of Gwen’s empowered basic attacks to limit her chances to heal, and remember that Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can create distance when there are many minions around.
Gwen.phase: In the mid game, keep looking for openings to engage and fight when Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. Later, Olaf will have trouble approaching a long-range team, so check your entry path and when Gwen uses her slows.
Gwen.teamfight: Prioritize Olaf’s role of reaching the backline damage dealers instead of fighting the frontline for a long time. Time Olaf Q Undertow’s armor reduction with an engage from allies who deal primarily physical damage. In a narrow approach, throw the axe behind the enemy team to slow them, then retrieve it. Counter Gwen R Needlework’s slow with Olaf R Ragnarok, but dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to the side.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so move to the side as she casts it to get out of the center. Gwen R Needlework slows and deals damage based on your max health. If you keep fighting after being hit, use Olaf R Ragnarok to counter the slow, but remember that you still take the damage. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end.

Illaoi.build: If healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God could turn a fight, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build armor first against Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, which make up her primary damage. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your max health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Illaoi.combo: Hit Illaoi in the direction she’s moving with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach and retrieve the axe where it lands. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking one of Illaoi’s attacks. Keep on her with basic attacks and finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Illaoi.escape: Engage just after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, her only mobility ability, provided Illaoi E Test of Spirit has missed. If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits and slows you, use Olaf R Ragnarok then to ignore the movement impairment and stick to her. If Illaoi has already used up her ways to impair your movement, don’t activate Olaf R Ragnarok early.
Illaoi.fight: Avoid Illaoi E Test of Spirit and engage just after you make her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Hit her with Olaf Q Undertow to slow her and reduce her armor, then approach while retrieving the axe and pressure her with basic attacks. After taking one of her attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out’s shield and attack speed to trade back, and save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish.
Illaoi.laning: Early on, keep the lane away from walls and farm from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. Drop Olaf Q Undertow between you and your opponent so retrieving the axe also brings you closer. Don’t fight for long near walls where tentacles have spawned.
Illaoi.phase: In the mid game, take advantage of openings when Illaoi E Test of Spirit and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson are down, but avoid fights near tentacles. Later, Olaf will have trouble approaching a long-range team, so choose your entry path carefully.
Illaoi.teamfight: Spread out in front of Illaoi, since Illaoi R Leap of Faith creates more tentacles when multiple champions are grouped. Don’t give her a target to hit during the brief time after she uses her ultimate. If you can’t afford to destroy the tentacles, draw Illaoi away from the wall. Olaf can use Olaf Q Undertow to create an entry path and Olaf R Ragnarok when needed to ignore movement impairments and reach the backline damage dealers.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so farm from outside its range and approach after she misses it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals heavy area damage for a short window, so don’t try to withstand it; back off and fight again afterward. You still take damage even if you activate Olaf R Ragnarok.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge could turn a fight, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Irelia.combo: After hitting her with Olaf Q Undertow, approach as you retrieve the axe and attack with basic attacks. After taking Irelia’s attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out. If Irelia withstands the damage with Irelia W Defiant Dance, finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing, which ignores damage reduction. If health is low and the kill isn’t certain, hold Olaf E Reckless Swing because it costs health.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the gap. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun lands, and keep fighting on top of her. If Irelia has already used up her crowd control, there’s no reason to activate Olaf R Ragnarok.
Irelia.fight: Close the gap and fight just after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Irelia is moving to slow her, then retrieve the axe as you close in and attack with basic attacks. After taking her attack, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed, and finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve it as you approach. Don’t throw Olaf Q Undertow if you won’t be able to pick up the axe.
Irelia.phase: Later, Olaf will have trouble approaching a long-range team, so watch for a good entry path.
Irelia.teamfight: If Irelia is looking to use Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet in a teamfight, focus her first.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can repeatedly dash to low-health minions and heal, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Counter the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet with Olaf R Ragnarok, and if you’re trapped inside the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Jax’s damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so get a way to reduce his attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Jax.combo: When Jax E Counter Strike ends, hit Jax in the direction he’s moving with Olaf Q Undertow to slow him, then retrieve the axe as you close in and attack with basic attacks. Follow with Olaf W Tough It Out and save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. If Jax E Counter Strike activates again, stop using basic attacks and use Olaf R Ragnarok just before the stun reaches you.
Jax.escape: The moment after you make Jax use Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to approach, since he has spent his ability to close the gap. If Jax E Counter Strike is also down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while retrieving the axe.
Jax.fight: After Jax E Counter Strike is down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach as you retrieve the axe. If Counter Strike is active, stop using basic attacks and create distance. When you do fight, take advantage of the fact that it can’t block ability damage by using Olaf Q Undertow and Olaf E Reckless Swing. Activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking an attack, when you need its shield and attack speed together.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t force an engage when you only have one ability.
Jax.phase: Later, Olaf will have trouble approaching a long-range team, so watch your teamfight entry path.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group with your allies inside its area stun range. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before the stun reaches you, then slow the opponent with Olaf Q Undertow as you approach the backline damage dealers. Also time Olaf Q Undertow’s armor reduction with an engage from allies who deal primarily physical damage.
Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and, when reactivated, applies an area stun and deals damage based on your max health.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, so also get movement speed to leave his poke zones. Considering Jayce E’s damage based on your max health, avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Jayce.combo: Hit Jayce in the direction he’s moving with Olaf Q Undertow to slow him, then retrieve the axe as you close in. Once you’re on him, attack with basic attacks and, after taking his retaliation, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed. Save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish with true damage.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down is your chance to engage. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and follow as you retrieve the axe. If the knockback is still available, use Olaf R Ragnarok when it impairs your movement.
Jayce.fight: Close the gap just after Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Jayce is moving and along a path where you can pick up the axe, then trade with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing once you’re on him. Don’t use Olaf R Ragnarok early; save it for when Jayce E Thundering Blow knocks you back and impairs your movement.
Jayce.laning: Early on, Jayce’s ranged poke is strong, so don’t blindly engage. Farm while moving from side to side. Use Olaf Q Undertow to last hit, but don’t throw the axe where you can’t retrieve it. If his poke takes too much of your health, don’t stay in lane and risk more; clear the wave, then return.
Jayce.phase: Early on, Jayce’s poke is strong, so Olaf should farm while protecting his growth and health. Later, his long range may make it hard to approach, so wait for an opening to engage.
Jayce.teamfight: When Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind Jayce to slow him and continue into retrieving the axe. Use Olaf R Ragnarok to overcome movement impairments and stick to Jayce in the backline, but keep attacking after you engage because you still take damage. Also time Olaf Q Undertow’s armor reduction with an engage from allies who deal physical damage.
Jayce.watch: Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate’s knockback can stop Olaf from closing in, so respond with Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after it hits. If you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, an empowered Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kayle.build: Build your core items as usual, but fit Executioner's Calling between them if the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing could turn a fight. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kayle’s damage, and get movement speed to dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Kayle.combo: Hit Kayle with Olaf Q Undertow, retrieve the axe as you approach, and attack with basic attacks. After taking her counterattack, use Olaf W Tough It Out for a shield and attack speed, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, save your finishing damage until the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so move in after she has used the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Kayle.fight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow along Kayle’s path and where you can retrieve the axe, then close in while she’s slowed. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Kayle Q Radiant Blast impairs your movement so you can keep up the pressure.
Kayle.phase: Olaf is strong early, so build a lead before Kayle gains ranged attack range.
Kayle.teamfight: Don’t spend too long fighting the frontline. Find a path to Kayle from the flank or outside vision. Approach when your team’s crowd control lands, then focus your damage after Kayle R Divine Judgment’s invulnerability ends.
Kayle.watch: Dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast because it slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, damage is blocked, so don’t pour on attacks; strike again once the invulnerability ends.

Kled.build: Build armor first against Kled’s main damage. Since Olaf has no mobility spell and can get locked down by crowd control, build tenacity. You can also consider reducing attack speed to delay Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth basic attack.
Kled.combo: Throw Olaf Q Undertow along Kled’s path to slow him, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking his combo, use Olaf W Tough It Out for a shield and attack speed, then save Olaf E Reckless Swing as the finishing blow. Around the time Kled’s crowd control lands, activate Olaf R Ragnarok and keep attacking with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Kled.escape: Even after Kled E Jousting is down, don’t rush the chase if Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available. Avoid the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and the fourth-attack window of Kled W Violent Tendencies; engage when he has no remaining charge available.
Kled.fight: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, back off and break its range before it pulls you in. Once Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth-attack window has passed and Kled E Jousting is down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and close in while retrieving the axe. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Kled’s crowd control lands so you can keep attacking.
Kled.laning: You’re strong in early melee trades, but Kled has many ways to lock you down, so fight within reach of Olaf Q Undertow’s axe. If you dismount Kled, watch his Courage meter; if you can’t kill him, create distance and prevent him from building Courage by hitting champions. He also gains Courage by killing minions in lane, so keep him away from the wave to maintain your advantage.
Kled.phase: If you don’t give Kled an early lead, his power drops sharply in lane and from the midgame onward. Later, Olaf has trouble reaching long-range compositions, so make use of the advantages you gained in your fights with Kled.
Kled.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from far away outside vision, so watch for it with flank vision. If you can’t stop it, use the fact that it charges at the first enemy champion it finds and hold formation behind the frontline. When enemy crowd control lands, respond with Olaf R Ragnarok. Reduce your target’s armor with Olaf Q Undertow and reach the backline damage dealers.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, his fourth basic attack deals a burst of damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay close long enough to take all four hits. Watch Kled’s approach, since Kled E Jousting followed by R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can make it hard to escape.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. You can add penetration against Malphite’s high armor, but also make use of the armor reduction from Olaf Q Undertow and the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Malphite.combo: Hit Malphite along his path with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach while retrieving the fallen axe. Once in range, use basic attacks. After taking his counterattack, activate Olaf W Tough It Out. Continue with basic attacks, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Malphite.escape: If Malphite E Ground Slam is also down, you can close in and fight without worrying about the attack speed reduction. If Malphite still has crowd control available, don’t activate Olaf R Ragnarok early; use it just before or after you’re hit.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start chipping away at his actual health. When Malphite E Ground Slam is down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and close in while retrieving the axe. After taking his counterattack, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Malphite.laning: Throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve the axe between you and your opponent. Break Malphite P Granite Shield and pressure him at short intervals, but don’t force an engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you.
Malphite.phase: Later in the game, Olaf has trouble reaching long-range enemies, so in teamfights, don’t spend time on the frontline; target the backline damage dealers.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock several of you up together, then counterattack as soon as his charge is down. Time Olaf R Ragnarok around Malphite’s crowd control and reach the backline damage dealers. As you engage, slow your target and reduce their armor with Olaf Q Undertow, retrieving the axe as you approach; once in range, follow with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it harder to approach or retreat, so don’t start a trade right after it hits you. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces your attack speed and cuts Olaf’s basic attack damage output, so engage after it’s down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be interrupted while charging and can knock up several people, so spread out from your allies when you can’t see where he is.

Nasus.build: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike is his main source of damage, so build armor first. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor in the affected area, so step out of it. Also account for the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands, but be cautious about stacking health alone because he deals damage based on your maximum health.
Nasus.combo: Hit Nasus along his path with Olaf Q Undertow, then close in while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking his counterattack, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and keep using basic attacks, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no way to create distance other than Flash, so engage when Nasus W Wither is down and you have an opening to approach. If you’re being hit by Wither, use Olaf R Ragnarok at that moment to remove the movement impairment. Delay the fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.fight: After taking Nasus’s counterattack, use the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out. Save Olaf E Reckless Swing for the finish.
Nasus.laning: Don’t push the lane all the way to Nasus’s turret; let the wave come toward you and pressure the spots where he tries to last hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Drop Olaf Q Undertow between you and Nasus so you can retrieve it while approaching, and look for a jungle gank if he steps forward.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks make him harder to deal with as the game goes on, so limit his growth early. Later, Olaf also has trouble reaching long-range opponents.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t face Nasus head-on for long while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance and let it run out. Use Olaf Q Undertow to create an approach path, and time Olaf R Ragnarok to counter movement impairments such as Nasus W Wither so you can reach the backline damage dealers.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces your movement speed and attack speed, so use Olaf R Ragnarok when it hits to remove the movement impairment and assess the distance. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid a direct fight and let its duration run out.

Ornn.build: Ornn deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so avoid prioritizing only one type of resistance. Olaf has no mobility spell and can be locked down by crowd control, so you can prioritize tenacity over resistances. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: Hit Ornn along his path with Olaf Q Undertow, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. Then activate Olaf W Tough It Out and continue using basic attacks, finishing with Olaf E Reckless Swing. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Ornn’s crowd control comes out and keep fighting at close range.
Ornn.escape: Don’t engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. Go in when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also unavailable and you can use Olaf R Ragnarok to withstand Ornn’s crowd control. Olaf has no skill to escape on his own, so keep your distance outside that window.
Ornn.fight: Start the fight away from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture’s pillar and from walls. Throw Olaf Q Undertow along Ornn’s path to slow him, then approach while retrieving the axe. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after Ornn’s crowd control lands, and after taking damage, use Olaf W Tough It Out for its shield and attack speed.
Ornn.laning: Early on, actively trade with melee Ornn, but throw Olaf Q Undertow so the axe lands between you and him for retrieval. If Ornn tries to craft an item, engage and attack to interrupt him. If Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture creates a pillar, avoid the area around it as you move.
Ornn.phase: In the midgame, use your lane advantage to push the game before Ornn’s items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades build up. Later, Olaf has trouble reaching long-range compositions, so carefully choose your engage angle.
Ornn.teamfight: Time Olaf Q Undertow with your physical damage dealers’ engage to reduce the armor of Ornn and other targets. Dodge the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and don’t stand in the line between the spirit and Ornn. When you engage, use Olaf R Ragnarok to get through crowd control and reach the backline damage dealers.
Ornn.watch: Avoid Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture’s pillar and nearby walls. If Ornn E Searing Charge hits that terrain, it can knock you up, so move toward open ground. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon's main damage. However, Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has armor penetration, so don't rely on stacking only health or armor. Mix in penetration against Pantheon's high armor, and make use of the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Pantheon.combo: Hit Pantheon with Olaf Q Undertow in the direction he is moving, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking Pantheon's attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out for a shield and attack speed, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing as the finishing hit. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to the stun when Pantheon W Shield Vault comes in.
Pantheon.escape: The moment after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down is your chance to engage. Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also a way for him to move, so try to engage before it comes back up.
Pantheon.fight: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Pantheon is moving to slow him, then close in while retrieving the axe. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault comes out, stop attacking from the front and hit him after it ends, or circle around to the side.
Pantheon.laning: Stay behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear's poke. Throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve the axe while approaching.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls off later, but Olaf also has trouble reaching teams with long range, so watch your approach path.
Pantheon.teamfight: If Olaf Q Undertow lowers Pantheon's armor, allies who deal physical damage benefit too. Don't pour attacks into the front of Pantheon E Aegis Assault; wait for it to end or move to the side.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so be careful when you enter its range. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, hold your attacks and wait for it to end, or circle around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking large amounts of health alone, and don't spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction she is moving, then approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking Poppy's counterattack, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and continue basic attacking, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before Poppy's crowd control comes out or right after it lands.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used is your chance to close the distance. Even if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, Olaf can walk up to her. If Poppy charges R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side to stay out of the area directly in front of her. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to Poppy's crowd control.
Poppy.fight: Bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge, then close the distance in open space. Slow her with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while retrieving the axe, but first take one of Poppy's attacks, then counterattack with the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out. Even if Poppy builds high armor, Olaf E Reckless Swing's true damage still goes through, so use it to finish her.
Poppy.laning: Trade in open space, with no wall or narrow passage behind you. Drop Olaf Q Undertow between you and your opponent so you can retrieve it while approaching. Step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first to prevent her from gaining a shield. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock's first hit lands, immediately leave the remaining zone.
Poppy.phase: In this phase, look for an opening when Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and fight in open space. Later, it becomes harder to approach teams with long range, so choose your entry path carefully.
Poppy.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in time with your physical-damage allies' engage to lower the enemy's armor. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to Poppy's crowd control and approach the backline carries. In a narrow entryway, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to slow them, then push in while retrieving the axe.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns and deals extra damage if it hits a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, immediately walk out of the remaining zone to avoid the second hit. When you see Poppy charging R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her line of attack.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against Renekton's main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.combo: After hitting Renekton with Olaf Q Undertow, approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking Renekton's first combo, use Olaf W Tough It Out for a shield and attack speed, and save Olaf E Reckless Swing for the finishing hit. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or right after the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator lands.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage is your window to close the distance. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and chase while retrieving the axe.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury, and counterattack up close right after he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Renekton is moving and where you can retrieve the axe, then approach with basic attacks.
Renekton.laning: Drop Olaf Q Undertow between you and your opponent so retrieving the axe and approaching happen in one move. Don't stand in or behind a minion wave for long, where Renekton E Slice and Dice can use it as a stepping stone.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value falls off from the midgame onward, so avoid giving up kills and keep farming. Later, carefully choose an approach path against teams with long range.
Renekton.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in time with your physical-damage allies' engage to lower the enemy's armor. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and approach the backline carries. In a narrow entryway, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to slow them, then go in while retrieving the axe.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger puts his Fury near or above half, watch out for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Empowered W breaks shields first and stuns, so don't try to block it by activating Olaf W Tough It Out in advance. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions as a stepping stone for a second dash, so don't stand in or behind a minion wave.

Riven.build: Riven's main damage is physical, so buy armor items first and build up your armor. Also get health to account for the finishing damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: If Riven Q Broken Wings is down, hit her with Olaf Q Undertow, approach while retrieving the axe, then use basic attacks. After taking Riven's counterattack, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and continue basic attacking while close, then finish with Olaf E Reckless Swing. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after the stun from Riven W Ki Burst or the knock-up from Riven Q Broken Wings lands.
Riven.escape: Go in after Riven has fully spent both Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, especially before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up. If only one mobility ability is down, she can escape with the remaining ability, so don't rush the chase. If Riven W Ki Burst or the crowd control from the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings is still available, time your engage so Olaf R Ragnarok can counter it.
Riven.fight: You can counterattack when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Throw Olaf Q Undertow where Riven's direction of movement and your axe-retrieval path overlap, then trade up close with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing. After taking one of Riven's combos, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and counterattack with its shield and attack speed.
Riven.laning: Look for early melee trades, but manage your distance first while all of Riven's dashes are available. Don't throw Olaf Q Undertow past the wave; drop it between you and Riven so you can retrieve it while approaching. If you can't retrieve the axe, the wait until your next Olaf Q Undertow will be long, so don't overcommit to the chase.
Riven.phase: In this phase, actively look for the opening when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions. Later, it becomes harder for Olaf to approach teams with long range, so choose your chance to engage carefully.
Riven.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in time with your physical-damage allies' engage to reduce Riven's armor. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to Riven's crowd control, then keep up basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing as you close in on the backline carries.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings closes the distance with three dashes and a knock-up, so back away when you see the first dash. While the stun from Riven W Ki Burst is available, don't use Olaf R Ragnarok in advance; use it just before or after the stun lands. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range increases and her finishing damage that scales with missing health is dangerous, so keep your distance until its duration ends.

Rumble.build: Consider magic-resistance defense items first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health. Also account for the magic resistance reduction from being hit by Rumble E Electro Harpoon.
Rumble.combo: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in Rumble's direction of movement to hit him, then approach while retrieving the axe. After using basic attacks up close and taking Rumble's attack, activate Olaf W Tough It Out. Use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish, but if your health is low and a kill isn't certain, save it because of its health cost.
Rumble.escape: After Rumble has also used Rumble W Scrap Shield, look for the moment its shield disappears to go in. Rumble has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so use Olaf Q Undertow to seize your chance to catch him. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon or Rumble R The Equalizer, and don't activate it before the slow comes out.
Rumble.fight: After Rumble W Scrap Shield is activated, hold your heavy damage until the shield disappears. After Rumble uses W, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while retrieving the axe. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon or Rumble R The Equalizer applies, then keep attacking once you're on him.
Rumble.laning: Keep enough distance that Rumble has to walk forward to fight you. Throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and Rumble where you can retrieve it, combining your approach with axe retrieval. If Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you first, don't stand there and take the second harpoon too.
Rumble.phase: At this point, look for a chance to get on Rumble while watching out for both harpoons and Rumble Q Flamespitter. Later, it becomes harder to approach teams with long range, so choose your entry path carefully.
Rumble.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to slow them, then go in while retrieving the axe. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon or Rumble R The Equalizer and get on the backline carries. You still take damage while R is active, so keep up basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing after going in.
Rumble.watch: If you get hit by both casts of Rumble E Electro Harpoon in a row, the slow becomes stronger and your magic resistance is reduced. If the first harpoon hits, immediately create distance to dodge the second. Rumble Q Flamespitter is more likely to damage you at close range, so if you don't plan to fight, minimize the time you spend near him.

Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett's basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Lowering attack speed can also help reduce the damage from Sett's basic attacks. The true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker can't be reduced by resistances, so avoid its center instead of just stacking more health.
Sett.combo: After hitting Sett with Olaf Q Undertow, approach while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. Then use Olaf W Tough It Out for attack speed and a shield, and save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. If Sett W Haymaker comes out, dodge the center of its targeting line, then continue the fight.
Sett.escape: Your window to go in is when Sett E Facebreaker is down and Sett R The Show Stopper is also unavailable.
Sett.fight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in Sett's direction of movement to slow him, then approach while retrieving the axe. If you've dealt enough damage to make Sett use Sett W Haymaker, dodge its center to the side, then get back on him. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when the crowd control from Sett E Facebreaker comes out. After taking Sett's damage, counterattack with the shield from Olaf W Tough It Out.
Sett.phase: After that, keep looking for chances to engage when Sett R The Show Stopper is down. Later, Olaf has trouble approaching teams with long range, so choose your entry path carefully.
Sett.teamfight: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in time with your physical-damage allies' engage to lower Sett's armor. Don't position on both sides of Sett with allies, so you can avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to crowd control, and once you engage, get on the backline carries instead of staying on the frontline.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker becomes dangerous just after Sett has taken a lot of damage, so if you've dealt heavy damage, briefly create distance and dodge the center of its targeting line to the side. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so don't stand with Sett between you and minions or an ally. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so watch out for its grab range while Sett has R available.
Sett.laning: Look for early melee trades, but throw Olaf Q Undertow so its axe lands between you and Sett, letting you retrieve it as you approach. If you throw the axe somewhere you can't retrieve it, you'll be exposed to counterattacks until your next Q. Avoid standing on the opposite side of Sett from a minion group so you can dodge the stun from Sett E Facebreaker.

Shen.build: Get tenacity first against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so if you build resistances, don't focus on only one type. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health.
Shen.combo: Hit Shen with Olaf Q Undertow in the direction he is moving, then approach by stepping on the dropped axe and use basic attacks. When your health has dropped after taking Shen's counterattack, use Olaf W Tough It Out for a shield and attack speed, then save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, delay your basic attacks until the zone ends.
Shen.escape: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, go in during the window when his only mobility and forced crowd control are down. Shen R Stand United is also a way for him to move, so don't assume you can commit to a chase just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down. In particular, look for an opening before Shen R Stand United comes back up.
Shen.fight: Just after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, hit him with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while retrieving the axe. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is placed, pause your basic attacks briefly and pressure him with Olaf Q Undertow and Olaf E Reckless Swing, which are not blocked by the zone. If Shen E Shadow Dash is still available, use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after the taunt lands.
Shen.laning: From the early game, throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and Shen where you can retrieve it, combining the trade with your approach. Rather than only looking for kills, push the lane and keep Shen occupied farming to increase the cost of his using Shen R Stand United to affect other lanes. If Shen disappears or you see the channeling animation for Shen R Stand United, alert your team immediately.
Shen.phase: Later, Olaf has trouble approaching teams with long range, so choose your chance to engage carefully.
Shen.teamfight: Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash and get on the backline carries. In a narrow entryway, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to slow them and retrieve the axe. Also land Olaf Q Undertow in time with your allies' physical-damage engage to use its armor reduction.
Shen.watch: Shen E Shadow Dash provides a taunt and movement, so avoid its dash path. Basic attacks from Olaf are nullified inside Shen W Spirit's Refuge.

Singed.build: First secure enough movement speed to get out of the poison trail and close the gap. Build magic resist rather than armor to withstand Singed's damage. Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking a lot of health alone.
Singed.combo: Slow Singed with Olaf Q Undertow, pick up the axe as you close in, and attack with basic attacks. After taking Singed's counterattack, use Olaf W Tough It Out to gain a shield and attack speed, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Singed W Mega Adhesive or Singed E Fling's crowd control comes out.
Singed.escape: The window after Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling have been used is a good time to close in. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so hit him with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while picking up the axe. If he still has crowd control, don't use Olaf R Ragnarok early; activate it just before or just after it catches you.
Singed.fight: Close in while picking up your axe, but stop chasing if you would have to stay in Singed Q Poison Trail for too long or don't have enough damage to finish him. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when Singed's crowd control comes out so you can stay on him.
Singed.laning: Throw Olaf Q Undertow to a spot between you and Singed where you can retrieve the axe as you approach. Don't chase recklessly along Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.phase: Olaf is strong early, so chip away at Singed's health and force him to recall. Singed becomes hard to kill once he has his core items, and Olaf can struggle to get close later, so make the most of your early lead.
Singed.teamfight: Don't chase Singed all the way while walking through his poison. Slow him with Olaf Q Undertow, then use Olaf R Ragnarok to ignore crowd control and reach Singed's backline. When an ally dealing physical damage engages, hitting Singed with Olaf Q Undertow also lets you make use of the armor reduction.
Singed.watch: Don't chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. When Singed R Insanity Potion is active, the poison also reduces healing, so move out of the trail. If Singed E Fling hits you while you're on Singed W Mega Adhesive, you'll also be rooted, so go around the adhesive.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor won't block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Stacking only health also increases the maximum-health-based damage of Sion P Glory in Death, so focus first on dodging Sion E Roar of the Slayer.
Sion.combo: Hit Sion with Olaf Q Undertow in the direction he's moving to slow him, then close in while picking up the axe and follow with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing. If you're committing to the fight, land Olaf Q Undertow, close in with basic attacks, and activate Olaf W Tough It Out; save Olaf E Reckless Swing, which deals true damage, to finish him. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after Sion's crowd control comes out.
Sion.escape: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash's charge to the side or make him use it early, then go in. Olaf has no ability to get himself out, so keep your distance while Sion still has a way to lock you down.
Sion.fight: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash sideways or make him use it early, then hit him with Olaf Q Undertow and close in while picking up the axe. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, attack right away to break the shield before it bursts. Use Olaf W Tough It Out after taking one of his attacks, when you're ready to counterattack; use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or just after crowd control catches you.
Sion.laning: Olaf is strong against melee opponents from the start, so trade by throwing Olaf Q Undertow between you and Sion, then picking it up as you close in. If you can't pick up the axe from where it lands, the gap until your next Olaf Q Undertow will be long, so don't throw it recklessly. If Sion keeps killing minions, his maximum health increases, so push the wave to disrupt his farming or use that time to gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: Keep disrupting Sion's farming in the mid game, and fight when Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught has been used. In the late game, Olaf can struggle to reach a long-range team, so don't let the game drag on while ignoring Sion.
Sion.teamfight: Rather than fighting Sion on the frontline for too long, use Olaf R Ragnarok to ignore crowd control and get onto the backline carries. In a narrow entryway, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to slow them, then go in as you pick up the axe. When an ally whose main damage is physical engages, hitting with Olaf Q Undertow also reduces armor and increases their damage.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash is dangerous when charged because it knocks you up and stuns you, so move sideways while he charges it. Don't meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side of his approach. Even after you take Sion down, Sion P Glory in Death activates, so immediately create distance and reposition.

Skarner.build: Decide first whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: Hit Skarner with Olaf Q Undertow in the direction he's moving to slow him, then approach while picking up the axe and land basic attacks. Follow up with Olaf W Tough It Out to endure his attacks and keep attacking; save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him with true damage.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to go in.
Skarner.fight: Close the gap right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact has been used. Slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while picking up the axe; after taking Skarner's attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out to counterattack with the shield and attack speed.
Skarner.laning: In early melee trades, throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and your opponent, then pick it up as you close in. Don't extend the trade if you can't retrieve the axe from where it lands or if you're backed up against a wall.
