Skarner.phase: Use this phase to take control and secure objectives, delaying Skarner's item completion. In the late game, Skarner gets tanky and Olaf can struggle to reach a long-range team, so choose your engage carefully.
Skarner.teamfight: Watch the positions of Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale, and avoid walls and the edges of objective pits. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when crowd control is coming; if you can engage, slow the backline with Olaf Q Undertow and close in on the carries while picking up the axe.

Teemo.build: Teemo's main damage is magic, so build magic resist first. Prepare Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key routes.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart has been used, throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Teemo is moving to slow him. Close in as you retrieve the axe and land basic attacks, then activate Olaf W Tough It Out and use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him. While blinded, deal damage with abilities instead of basic attacks.
Teemo.escape: Engage right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart has been used. If Teemo has also used Teemo W Move Quick, take the chance to close the gap. Just before or just after Teemo R Noxious Trap slows you, use Olaf R Ragnarok to chase without being hindered by movement impairments.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart has been used. Slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and approach while picking up the axe; if you decide to go in, keep up the pressure. After taking Teemo's attacks, use Olaf W Tough It Out to make use of both its shield and attack speed.
Teemo.laning: Avoid trades where you only take basic attacks inside Teemo's range and then back off, and use Olaf Q Undertow to secure last hits as you grow. Throw the axe where you can retrieve it while closing in. Avoid the edge of bushes without vision, and wait for Teemo to come out of a bush so you can counterattack.
Teemo.phase: In the mid game, pressure Teemo with your jungler so he doesn't have time to plant mushrooms. In the late game, it's hard to get close to a long-range team, so watch for traps along your engage path as you move.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow passages. Slow enemies along your engage path with Olaf Q Undertow, and use its armor reduction to support an ally dealing physical damage as they engage. When you are affected by movement impairments, activate Olaf R Ragnarok and reach the backline carries.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so don't try to auto-attack while blinded; deal damage with abilities or back away. Because of Teemo E Toxic Shot, trades where you take just one basic attack and then back away are unfavorable. Teemo R Noxious Trap turns invisible and slows, so be careful near objectives and in narrow passages.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on your maximum health and steals resistances, so avoid stacking only health or resistances. If Trundle's healing could turn the fight around, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Trundle.combo: Hit Trundle with Olaf Q Undertow, step on the dropped axe as you close in, then use basic attacks. After taking damage, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and keep attacking with basic attacks before using Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him. When you need to endure the movement impairment from Trundle E Pillar of Ice, activate Olaf R Ragnarok; after activating it, keep hitting him with basic attacks or E to extend its duration.
Trundle.escape: The window after Trundle E Pillar of Ice has been used and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired is a good time to close in. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and follow while picking up the axe. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice is still available, don't activate Olaf R Ragnarok early; use it when the movement impairment hits.
Trundle.fight: Reengage once Trundle Q Chomp's attack damage reduction ends and you have moved out of Trundle W Frozen Domain. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Trundle is moving to slow him, then approach while picking up the axe and pressure him with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing. After taking one round of damage, activate Olaf W Tough It Out to use the shield and attack speed together.
Trundle.laning: In early melee fights, throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and your opponent, then approach while picking it up. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him when nearby enemy units die, so don't drag out a fight where you only chip away at his health through a large wave. If you've taken his health down, claim an advantage right away or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.teamfight: Don't waste time fighting the frontline while Trundle R Subjugate is active; go for the backline carries. Throw Olaf Q Undertow along your engage path to slow and retrieve the axe, and use Olaf R Ragnarok when you need to withstand the movement impairment from Trundle E Pillar of Ice. If an ally dealing physical damage engages, make use of Olaf Q Undertow's armor reduction too.
Trundle.watch: Right after Trundle Q Chomp hits you, your attack damage is reduced and trading is unfavorable, so back away until the effect ends. Trundle gains strong attack speed and healing inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so leave it and wait out its duration. In a narrow path, Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape, so fight in open areas and move sideways as soon as the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your resistances and becomes tankier, so create distance.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. Udyr R Wingborne Storm's magic damage isn't blocked by armor, and Olaf R Ragnarok grants magic resist while active. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle could turn a fight around, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Udyr.combo: Hit Udyr with Olaf Q Undertow, then close in while retrieving the axe and use basic attacks. After taking an attack, use Olaf W Tough It Out to gain a shield and attack speed, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun is about to hit or has just hit, activate Olaf R Ragnarok.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede combines a stun with a dash, so the moment after he uses it is your chance to engage. While he can't stun the same target again, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and close the gap while picking up the axe.
Udyr.fight: Engage after you've taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede or immediately after you make him use it. Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Udyr is moving to slow him, then approach while picking up the axe. When Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is gone, use Olaf W Tough It Out to continue your counterattack.
Udyr.laning: Udyr shows up from the jungle to gank, so place vision at key routes and jungle entrances. Don't step forward in lane when Udyr is missing. If you encounter him, throw Olaf Q Undertow so the axe lands between him and you, giving you a path to retrieve it.
Udyr.phase: In the mid game, keep choosing fights when Udyr E Blazing Stampede has been used. In the late game, it can be hard to reach a long-range team, so choose your engage opportunities carefully.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't spend a long time attacking Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Slow enemies along your engage path with Olaf Q Undertow, then use Olaf R Ragnarok timed against Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun to get onto vulnerable enemies in the backline. Once you've engaged, keep attacking with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Udyr.watch: Watch out for Udyr E Blazing Stampede's dash and stun on its first attack. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so you still take that damage even with Olaf R Ragnarok active.

Urgot.build: Build armor first since most of Urgot’s damage is physical. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Urgot has relatively high armor, so add armor penetration to your offense and make use of Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage.
Urgot.combo: Once Urgot E Disdain is down, throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Urgot is moving. Approach while retrieving the axe and land basic attacks, then activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking his counterattack. Save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him, but if health is low and the kill isn’t certain, account for its cost to your own health and hold it.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so the moment it misses is your window to engage. Keep your distance while Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot E Disdain are still available. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after you get hit by crowd control, then extend the duration with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing once you’re on top of him.
Urgot.fight: Once Urgot E Disdain is down, hit him with Olaf Q Undertow to slow him, then close in as you retrieve the axe. After taking Urgot’s attack, counterattack with the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after Urgot’s crowd control hits, but remember it does not block damage or an execute.
Urgot.laning: Don’t blindly run at Urgot. Farm with Olaf Q Undertow and grow stronger. Throw the axe only where you can retrieve it, and engage when Urgot E Disdain is down or your jungler can follow up. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, walk out of its range.
Urgot.phase: Still, prolonged face-to-face fights let Urgot P Echoing Flames damage stack up, so even in the early and mid game, look for an opening when Urgot E Disdain is down. In the late game, it becomes harder for Olaf to reach long-range compositions, so choose your engage carefully.
Urgot.teamfight: When an ally dealing physical damage engages, hit Urgot with Olaf Q Undertow to reduce his armor. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so use your frontline’s position to protect allies behind them. Rather than fighting the frontline for long, use Olaf R Ragnarok around the enemy crowd control and reach the backline damage dealers.
Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain dashes in and stuns, so keep your distance and look for an opening right after it misses. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it slows you and Urgot W Purge also focuses its fire on you, so dodge the projectile as it comes your way. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before your health reaches the execute threshold.

Volibear.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul can turn a fight, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Volibear.combo: Throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Volibear is moving, then close in as you retrieve the axe and land basic attacks. After taking one of Volibear’s attacks, activate Olaf W Tough It Out and counterattack with its shield and attack speed. Save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him, and time Olaf R Ragnarok for the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Volibear.escape: The opening to engage comes when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down and his P The Relentless Storm stacks have fallen off. If Volibear R Stormbringer is still available, don’t chase deep just because Q is down. Engage during a window when Volibear R Stormbringer is also down, slowing him with Olaf Q Undertow as you close in.
Volibear.fight: Avoid fighting while Volibear builds stacks of P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions or monsters, then engage as soon as the stacks fall off. Dodge Volibear E Sky Splitter, then hit him with Olaf Q Undertow and close in as you retrieve the axe. Don’t use Olaf R Ragnarok as soon as you engage; time it for the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Volibear.laning: In early melee trades, throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and Volibear to aim for both a slow and an axe pickup. If you see the area for Volibear E Sky Splitter, step to the side, then approach again. Don’t keep up a shaky trade unless you can handle the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul and finish him.
Volibear.phase: At this stage, pressure Volibear when his P The Relentless Storm stacks fall off. In the late game, it becomes harder to reach long-range compositions, so look for an engage path to use Olaf R Ragnarok in teamfights.
Volibear.teamfight: Land Olaf Q Undertow when an ally dealing physical damage engages to reduce the target’s armor. Time Olaf R Ragnarok for the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, and reach the backline damage dealers instead of staying on the frontline. If Volibear has stacks of P The Relentless Storm, wait for them to fall off before taking the fight.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash boosts his movement speed so he can close in and stun you, so wait outside the range of his empowered basic attack. If you see the marker for Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. While Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under a turret at low health.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Attack speed reduction slows both Yasuo’s basic attacks and the timing of his whirlwind, while magic resistance is worth considering against the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Yasuo is moving to slow him and close in as you retrieve the axe. Once you’re on him, land basic attacks, then activate Olaf W Tough It Out after taking his counterattack. Keep attacking, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing as the finishing blow.
Yasuo.escape: The opening to engage comes right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s whirlwind misses or has been used. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t commit to a chase just because he used it once. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after the knockup lands to remove the movement restriction and fight at close range.
Yasuo.fight: Use Olaf Q Undertow to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then trade in earnest once it’s gone. Immediately after dodging Yasuo’s whirlwind or baiting it out, slow him with Olaf Q Undertow and close in as you retrieve the axe. After taking a round of damage, counterattack with the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out.
Yasuo.laning: Keeping the wave thin on your side of the lane reduces the number of minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and Yasuo so you can approach while retrieving the axe. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, find another angle for the axe or hold it until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.phase: At this point, look for a window when Yasuo’s whirlwind is down. In the late game, it becomes harder for Olaf to reach long-range compositions, so check your engage path.
Yasuo.teamfight: If you land Olaf Q Undertow on Yasuo as your allies deal physical damage, you can make use of the armor reduction at the same time. Use Olaf R Ragnarok in response to Yasuo’s knockup, then reach the backline damage dealers without getting stuck on the frontline. In a narrow approach, throw Olaf Q Undertow behind the enemy to aim for both a slow and an axe pickup.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a whirlwind after hitting twice in a row, so if it’s stacked, move off the line and dodge to the side. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach through minions, and Yasuo R Last Breath can follow up on a knockup, so manage your distance around large minion waves.

Yone.build: There’s no information available to determine a specific first purchase, but prioritize getting enough movement speed to leave the telegraphed attack areas. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so if you build resistances, consider both armor and magic resistance.
Yone.combo: Hit Yone with Olaf Q Undertow in the direction he’s moving, then close in as you retrieve the axe and land basic attacks. After taking one of Yone’s attacks, counterattack with the shield and attack speed from Olaf W Tough It Out. Save Olaf E Reckless Swing to finish him, but if remaining health is low and the kill isn’t certain, account for its cost to your own health and hold it.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage right away just because either Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound is down. Check his other mobility tools too, and especially look for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back off cooldown. If Yone still has crowd control available, don’t activate Olaf R Ragnarok early; use it just before or after you’re hit.
Yone.fight: Don’t engage first while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind is ready. If the whirlwind disappears or Yone’s engage tool is down, throw Olaf Q Undertow somewhere you can retrieve it, slow him, and close in. Use Olaf R Ragnarok just before or after Yone’s knockup hits, then keep up the pressure with basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Yone.laning: Still, when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind is ready, wait outside its range for the stacks to disappear. Throw Olaf Q Undertow between you and the enemy so retrieving the axe and closing in happen in one move.
Yone.phase: In the late game, it becomes harder for Olaf to reach long-range compositions, so be more careful about your engage path and Yone’s remaining mobility tools.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow by hitting several of you. Since Yone R Fate Sealed moves behind the last champion in its path, check before a teamfight that you aren’t standing alone at the very back of the formation. Use Olaf R Ragnarok when crowd control hits and reach the backline damage dealers; time Olaf Q Undertow with an ally’s physical damage engage to make use of the armor reduction.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, he’s preparing to engage with the whirlwind, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Watch for Yone’s attacks with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed after he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound. You can answer the movement restriction from Yone R Fate Sealed with Olaf R Ragnarok, but you still take the damage.

Yorick.build: Build armor first, considering the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage, which armor alone won’t stop, and they deal damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites can turn a fight, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Yorick.combo: Hit Yorick with Olaf Q Undertow to slow him, then close in as you retrieve the axe and land basic attacks. After taking his attack, gain a shield and attack speed with Olaf W Tough It Out, then use Olaf E Reckless Swing as the finishing blow. When Yorick W Dark Procession restricts your movement, use Olaf R Ragnarok and stay on him to keep attacking.
Yorick.escape: The opening to engage comes after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses. Yorick has no mobility, so once you’re on him, he has a hard time creating distance, but hold Olaf R Ragnarok until Yorick W Dark Procession restricts your movement rather than using it early.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward to start a fight. Clear the Mist Walkers first, then throw Olaf Q Undertow in the direction Yorick is moving and somewhere you can retrieve the axe; slow him and close in. If Yorick W Dark Procession appears, use Olaf R Ragnarok to counter its movement restriction and keep attacking.
Yorick.laning: Make use of Olaf’s strength in early melee trades, but don’t fight where Yorick has built up a lot of graves. Push the lane so Yorick can’t clear the wave on his side, and throw Olaf Q Undertow where you can retrieve the axe and follow it in. After Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, step forward to farm or trade damage.
Yorick.phase: In the mid game, watch the positions of Yorick’s Mist Walkers and Maiden of the Mist for a chance to fight Yorick himself, and consider objective trades elsewhere instead of fixating only on side-lane pressure. In the late game, it becomes harder for Olaf to reach long-range compositions, so choose your engage path carefully.
Yorick.teamfight: Land Olaf Q Undertow as an ally whose main damage is physical engages to reduce the target’s armor. Use Olaf R Ragnarok against movement restrictions to reach the backline damage dealers, then keep attacking with basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your max health, so watch the projectile’s path and dodge it. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it. Avoid fighting where Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles and the Mist Walkers are together.
